title: 成功路径通过，异常路径待补
premise: 补丁、轮转和上限试点均有结果，Hannah报告自动化测试覆盖缺口。
listeningTask: 分清已通过的测试和今日计划补充的测试。

lines.en: Our test fixture covers successful rotation already. Permission failures still need an explicit case.
lines.zh: 测试预置环境已覆盖成功轮转，权限失败还需要明确用例。

lines.en: Okay, I'll add a denied-write scenario today. The runner must stop without deleting logs.
lines.zh: 好，我今天添加禁止写入场景。执行器必须停止且不删除日志。

lines.en: What about deleted but still open files? Disk usage can differ from directory totals.
lines.zh: 已删除但仍打开的文件呢？磁盘使用可能不同于目录总量。

lines.en: That case belongs in the diagnostics test. No cleanup of open descriptors by default.
lines.zh: 这个场景属于诊断测试，默认不清理仍打开的描述符。

lines.en: Just to confirm, no production fault injection, right? Test failures stay inside isolated environments.
lines.zh: 我确认一下，不在生产注入故障，对吧？失败测试留在隔离环境。

lines.en: Right, and repeated runs should be idempotent. The second run must not restart healthy services.
lines.zh: 对，多次运行应幂等，第二次不能重启健康服务。

lines.en: We'll dry-run it first for intended changes. Restart count should remain unchanged on repeats.
lines.zh: 先预演计划变更，重复运行时重启计数应不变。

lines.en: Capture both expected and actual changes. A successful exit alone won't establish safety.
lines.zh: 记录预期和实际变化，仅退出成功不能证明安全。

lines.en: My action item is the descriptor case. It should take roughly an hour today.
lines.zh: 我的待办是描述符场景，今天大约需要一小时。

lines.en: So, report coverage gaps alongside passing tests. We'll discuss implementation after this short standup.
lines.zh: 因此报告通过测试时也报告覆盖缺口。实现细节留到短站会后讨论。

scene: 补丁、轮转和上限试点均有结果，Hannah报告自动化测试覆盖缺口。
